templates.text:
Choose ten English {word_class} whose meanings and uses differ from one another as much as possible.
Use ordinary vocabulary. Avoid proper names, specialist terminology, and multi-word expressions.
Consider each word's different meanings when choosing the list.
Return exactly ten words as a JSON array of strings, without explanations or formatting fences.

Give me ten English {word_class} with meanings that are as far apart as possible.
Choose familiar single words from different semantic areas. Do not use names, technical jargon, or phrases.
Account for the different senses of each word.
Your entire answer must be a JSON array containing exactly ten strings, with one word per string.

Make a list of ten English {word_class} that maximizes semantic variety across the list.
Each entry should be an ordinary single word. Exclude proper names and specialized terminology.
Try to avoid overlap in both meanings and uses, including alternative word senses.
Output only a valid JSON array of ten word strings.

Find a set of ten English {word_class} that are as unrelated to each other as you can make them.
Use common vocabulary, single words, and no proper names or specialist terms.
Think about all the meanings the words can have when judging relatedness.
Respond with exactly ten strings in a JSON array and no additional text.

Select ten English {word_class} spanning widely different semantic domains.
The words should have as little overlap in meaning and use as possible, even considering their multiple senses.
Keep to ordinary single-word vocabulary; avoid names, jargon, and multi-word entries.
Return the list as a JSON array of exactly ten strings. Do not add commentary.

For a divergent association task, supply ten English {word_class} that are maximally different in meaning and usage.
Pick everyday single words rather than proper names, technical terms, or phrases.
Consider alternative meanings as well as the most obvious meaning of each word.
The answer must consist solely of a JSON array with ten strings.

Write ten English {word_class}, choosing the list so that the words resemble one another in meaning as little as possible.
Use ordinary vocabulary and one word per entry. Leave out proper names and specialized or multi-word terms.
Include different senses and uses in your judgment of semantic similarity.
Output exactly ten strings inside a JSON array, with nothing before or after it.

strict_reminder: Only generate the requested word class: {word_class}. Every one of the ten entries must be usable as that class; do not substitute another word class.
